extensionDescription.message: Opens your GitHub pull requests in collapsed tab groups when Firefox starts.

actionTitleLoading.description: Toolbar button tooltip while a refresh is running.

actionTitleError.description: Toolbar button tooltip after a failed refresh.

error.example: The GitHub token is invalid or expired.

groupMine.description: Title of the tab group holding pull requests authored by the user.

groupReview.description: Title of the tab group holding pull requests awaiting the user's review.

errorNoToken.message: No GitHub token configured. Open the extension options to add one.

errorUnauthorized.message: The GitHub token is invalid or expired.

errorForbidden.message: GitHub refused the request. Check the token permissions.

errorSsoRequired.message: The token must be authorized for the organization's SAML SSO.

errorRateLimited.message: GitHub rate limit reached. Try again later.

errorRateLimitedUntil.message: GitHub rate limit reached. Try again after $TIME$.

errorInvalidQuery.message: GitHub rejected the search. Check the organization name.

errorTimeout.message: GitHub did not respond in time.

errorNetwork.message: Could not reach GitHub. Check your network connection.

errorUnexpected.message: Unexpected error. See the browser console for details.
